[quote=corzerran;61376025]She nodded. [i]Indeed. I know we are allied through EDU, but to make things more official between our states we should get an official defense pact.[/i]

Kain took the tea with a nod of acknowledgement and appreciation. She took a small sip.

[i]I think a treaty with a full pledge to defend the other is in order, to be renewed every ten years?[/i][/quote]
[i]"I should think that reasonable. Your state and ours, they are slavic sisters, no? We share Maslenitsa, we share Lent. We should aim towards more cultural exchange, expand visas for education and work, lessen restrictions on travel and business."[/i]

She sipped her coffee as a slight grin played on her face,

[i]"The easiest things to accomplish, as I'm sure you know."[/i]

[Spoiler=Floueschia vs Valddera]The match begins of the first match of group E begins with Floueschia and Valddera, both sides looking to take points in the groups, the game kicks off with Valddera playing a balanced syle agains the leaning attack of Floueschia, though it doesn't continue on long as Valdderan attacking midfielder Maarash Ilvand manages to break though Floueschia's defense through a mistaken pass and puts it solo goal into the bottom corner, making it one-nil for the first half as it ends for an up advantage for Valddera. In the second half, Floueschia doesn't wait long as their defender gets a header goal from a corner played into Valddera's box, making it level for one-one. Just 11 minutes later, Valdderan striker Karim Velzad gets a controversial penalty, though the referee counts it in the end, as Velzad steps up to take it and dputs it beautifully in the top corner, making it 1-2 for Valddera, the game drags on long enough for Valddera to keep their score as it ends 1-2.
